## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New public items carry a TSDoc comment, and anything user-facing is in the README
- [ ] A test covers the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] The change runs on Node 18, the version `engines` declares, or the bump is intentional and noted
- [ ] `src/generated/` is only touched by `./generate-api.sh`, once the change is live in the API's published specification
